name: getDoctorAvailability
shortDescription: Retrieves a doctor's available appointment slots based on their clinical schedule and existing bookings.
description:
Overview

Retrieves a doctor's available slots based on their clinical schedule and existing appointments. This function helps patients and administrators find suitable times for new bookings.

Intended use

Called by the UI (patient or admin) to display a doctor's availability for appointment scheduling. The parameters include the doctor ID and a date range. It returns a list of available time slots.

Logic

  1. Validate the input parameters, ensuring a valid doctor ID and date range are provided.
  2. Query the Doctor entity to retrieve the doctor's clinicalSchedule.
  3. Query the Appointment entity to retrieve all existing appointments for the specified doctor within the given date range.
  4. Process the doctor's clinicalSchedule and existing appointments to calculate and identify available time slots.
  5. Return a list of available time slots.

Entities

  • Doctor
  • Appointment
  • HospitalSetting
